_comment: CRO (Chief Risk Officer) registry for Gate 4 (named approval record).
Gate 4 enforces a name-registry check: the approval_name must appear in
This is not authentication — it only confirms the typed name matches an entry.
It proves nothing about who actually typed the name.
Anyone with write access to this file can add names.
The registry check prevents non-CRO or unregistered names from being recorded;
it does not authenticate identity. A production authorization model requires
different infrastructure (e.g., directory service, certificate, MFA).
